platform: SomaFM Channel-Specific Digital Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: SomaFM's official Submit Music page authorizes digital submissions for a limited current set of channels through published channel-specific email addresses. A human must confirm that the selected MarcsMusic release complies with SomaFM's hard no-AI-music restriction, recheck the current accepting-channel list, choose exactly one best-fit mailbox, prepare a Bandcamp YUM code or permissioned downloadable folder, and verify 256 kbps or v0 high-quality VBR 44.1 kHz MP3 files and metadata. Do not use WAV, AIFF, FLAC, 128 kbps MP3, SoundCloud, YouTube, Mixcloud, Facebook, Haulix or physical CDs. International eligibility remains unconfirmed, duplicate delivery to multiple music directors is prohibited, and the reviewer must stop if authentication, payment, consent or protected controls appear.
